$comment: Source: SEMH audit 2026-08-04, adapted. Machine-readable semantic checks consumed by LundyLoop/tools/semantic_integrity_check.py. Every rule is DERIVED from the file under test — this file never holds a parallel copy of any lesson fact, per the estate rule 'never keep two copies where one can be derived'.
principle: Assert that a lesson's surfaces agree WITH EACH OTHER. Never compare a lesson against an external list of expected values; such a list is a second copy and will go stale.

measurement_rules.data_uri_note: 200 tracked *.html files carry base64 data-URIs at 6aaffb7; every text count inflates unless they are stripped first.
measurement_rules.null_delimited_note: Filenames in this estate contain apostrophes AND spaces (e.g. '5_6 Local Choice/'). Whitespace-splitting grep output has produced phantom files before.
measurement_rules.truncation_note: Piping a claim-feeding search through head has produced a false scope three times in this estate.
measurement_rules.zero_replay_note: A zero result is only believed after the same detector is replayed against an input where it MUST be non-zero.
measurement_rules.browser_evidence_rule: jsdom is a DOM stub, not a browser. Any result derived from it says so in the same sentence. Layout, print geometry and real navigation require a browser-capable environment or the result is UNVERIFIED, never inferred.

checks.name: subject_consistency
checks.description: Every pupil-facing surface naming a subject names the SAME subject as the deck banner.

checks.name: week_consistency
checks.description: Every surface naming a week number names the same week as the banner, EXCEPT surfaces that legitimately describe a multi-week artefact.
checks.known_legitimate_exception: A cut list or similar multi-week sheet may name several weeks in a sentence describing its own lifespan, e.g. 'Week 1 you start it, Week 2 you fill it from your blueprint, Week 3 you cut from it'. This is not staleness.

checks.name: title_consistency
checks.description: The deck title, the knowledge-organiser title and any print-pack heading agree.

checks.name: outcome_ownership
checks.description: Success criteria quoted in the midpoint peer-check must be drawn from THIS deck's own 'I can' outcomes, not another lesson's.
checks.derived_from: the set of 'I can ...' strings in the file
checks.provenance: Found 2026-08-04 in all six BUILD_DT decks: the midpoint modal quoted CAREERS_W1_My_Strengths criteria ('I can name two of my real strengths' / 'I can give an example of each strength in action') while each deck carried its own correct D&T outcomes elsewhere in the same file.

checks.name: completion_summary_consistency
checks.description: Where a completion or summary surface exists, its named evidence product matches the deck's independent-work product.
checks.note: Absence of a completion surface is NOT a failure. The BUILD_DT decks have none by design.

checks.name: next_lesson_pointer
checks.description: Any 'next lesson' pointer names week N+1 of the same subject, or is absent.

checks.name: timer_contract
checks.description: The initial timer display, the Independent Work data-timer, the configured total and the reset value must agree.
checks.assertion: initial_display_seconds == configured_total == configured_left, and data-timer minutes == configured_total/60
checks.repair_shape: DERIVATION — render the display from the configured duration. Editing the display string separately in N files preserves the defect class.
checks.report_only_reason: HANDOVER.md line 395-398 places estate data-timer values under 'The human's open calls (not the session's to decide)': 'No session edits timers in passing — candidate estate-wide question.' INSTRUMENTS.md line 323 lists 'Fix the timer contract — go' as an AWAITED authorisation. This check reports; it never licenses an edit.

checks.name: screen_print_task_identity
checks.description: A task described on screen and mirrored in the print pack must describe the same task.
checks.note: Lesson text is frequently MIRRORED in the print pack. Count occurrences whole-file before any replacement and patch both surfaces.

checks.name: tier_vocabulary
checks.description: Tier names are Supported / Standard / Stretch.

checks.name: colour_alone
checks.description: A status or route cue conveyed by colour must also carry an icon AND a word.

must_stay_empty: the 24-week GROW/LAUNCH Art gap (Autumn 2 + Spring 1) — not stubbed, not placeholdered

dt_v5_restrictions.no_printpack_id_changes: no adding or removing ids in printPack() lists in either direction
dt_v5_restrictions.open_items_7: the 6 D&T witness files' missing section 5 learner line is OPEN_ITEMS #7, awaiting Matt's word — do not add it

ll_g_loop_mark.expected: DERIVE IT, DO NOT ASSUME. Recorded as 45 at the time of writing.
ll_g_loop_mark.rule: the same set before and after any change

written_closure_line.marker: What I said, and what it changed
